notes: This is a distinct, privately-operated cottage product within Ol Pejeta Conservancy - separate from the Conservancy's own Pelican House/Stables/Camping products (see ol-pejeta-conservancy-2026.json). Both sit on the same conservancy and both charge the same conservancy Conservation Fee and Bed-night levy on top.
Contract (Sunworld) rate confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 exactly across every line (e.g. High Fully Inclusive 2 adults: $483 = $690 x 0.70). This is effectively a 30% discount tier.

Two folders hold near-duplicate rate cards for the same property: 'OL PEJETA' folder has a Rack-only card; 'OL PEJETA SAFARI COTTAGES' folder has a fuller card showing both Contract and Rack figures side by side. Treat the OL PEJETA SAFARI COTTAGES version as authoritative/more complete.
